title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, 3.7 Improper Integrals: Evaluate an integral over an infinite interval.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, 3.7 Improper Integrals: Evaluate an integral over an infinite interval.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, section "3.7 Improper Integrals", prints these objectives: "Evaluate an integral over an infinite interval." "Evaluate an integral over a closed interval with an infinite discontinuity within the interval." "Use the comparison theorem to determine whether a definite integral is convergent.". The section text says: "Is the area between the graph of f ( x ) = 1 x and the x -axis over the interval [ 1 , + ∞ ) finite or infinite? If this same region is revolved about the x -axis, is the volume finite or infinite? Surprisingly, the area of the region described is infinite, but the volume of the solid obtained by revolving this region about the x -axis is finite." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
